answer: Creating a fake sybil identity requires acquiring and staking a fresh relic plus a bond, so an attacker flooding N identities pays N times the stake and risks slashing on every one, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique violet-sealed relic token minted once per verified identity, and the haven registry locks that relic to a bonded wallet. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
